v: Ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim reyal t'a Judá, ix k'och winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado, yik syak'an owal heb' t'a Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix och hoyan heb' t'a spatik chonhab' chi'.

Ha Dios Kajalil ix ak'anoch winhaj rey Joacim chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' anima aj Judá yet' jantak yamk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a stemplo Dios. Ha juntzanh yamk'ab' chi', ix yik'kot winh, ix jawi t'a Babilonia tik, ix schekan winh ak'chajoch t'a spatil sdiosal b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji t'a sdiosal winh chi'.

Ayik ix jawi heb', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Aspenaz, haton winh yajal yaj t'a heb' yilumal sdespacho winh rey chi' to sik'chajel jaywanhok heb' winh kelemtak t'a skal heb' yinhtilal heb' winh rey aj Judá chi' yet' t'a skal heb' yinhtilal heb' niwak yopisio ix ik'chajkot chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha heb' winh kelemtak chi', yowalil te wach' yilji heb' winh, malaj jab'ok spaltail sniwanil heb' winh, jelan heb' winh, ay spensar heb' winh, snachajel tas yuj heb' winh, heb' winh smoj wal yak'an serwil t'a palacio. Yowalil sk'ayb'ej sti' heb' caldeo heb' winh yet' tas tz'ib'ab'il yuj heb'.

Ix yalanpax winh rey t'a winhaj Aspenaz chi' to a swael winh yet' swino winh syab'lej heb' winh kelemtak chi', sk'ayb'ajpax oxeok ab'il heb' winh. Slajwi chi', tz'och heb' winh yak' serwil winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak ix sik'chajel yuj winhaj Aspenaz chi', hata' ayoch winhaj Daniel, winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías. Haton heb' winh tik ix kot t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá.

Ix k'exchaj sb'i heb' winh yuj winhaj Aspenaz chi'. Ha winhaj Daniel chi', Beltsasar ix sb'iej winh, haxo winhaj Ananías, Sadrac ix sb'iej winh, haxo pax winhaj Misael, Mesac ix sb'iej winh, haxo winhaj Azarías jun, Abed-nego ix sb'iej winh.

Ha winhaj Daniel chi', ix sna winh to manh ol swalaj juntzanh tas ay yowalil yuj sley Dios, yuj chi' ix tewi winh t'a winhaj Aspenaz chi' to max ak'ji pural winh swaan swael winh rey yet' tas syuk'ej winh.
Ix och Dios yet' winhaj Daniel chi', yuj chi' te wach' winh t'a yol sat winhaj Aspenaz chi'. Wach'chom icha chi',

palta ix yal winhaj Aspenaz chi' icha tik: --Tzin xiw t'a winh wajalil, yujto a winh ix halani tas ol he wa''a yet' tas ol eyuk'ej. Q'uinalok haxo ol yilan winh to b'aktak ex t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh kelemtak tik, ol am in schek miljokcham winh rey chi' eyuuj, xchi winh.
Haxo winhaj Aspenaz chi', ix yak'och jun yilumal winhaj Daniel chi' winh yet' heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Daniel chi' t'a winh yilumal chi' icha tik:
--Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzonh ak' prowal t'a lajunheok k'ual. Anhej komon wael tzak' t'ayonh, mokab' ak' nok' chib'ej ko chi'a, anhej pax ha ha' tzak' kuk'ej.

Ayik stz'akwi lajunhe' k'ual chi', tzonh a lajb'an yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh kelemtak swaan swael winh rey chi'. Ichato chi' syalxo ak'an t'ayonh tas ol ko wa chi', hato syal chajtil kiljiochi, xchi winh.
Ix schaan sk'ol winh tas ix sk'an heb' winh chi'. Lajunhe' k'ual ix ak'ji prowal heb' winh.
Haxo yik ix tz'akwi lajunhe' k'ual chi', ix iljiochi to te wach' yilji heb' winh, te tek'an heb' winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh ix waan swael winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi', majxo ak'jilaj wael yet' wino yik winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yuj winh yilumal heb' winh chi', haxonhej komon wael ix yak' winh t'a heb' winh.

Ha heb' winh kelemtak chi' schanhwanhil, ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' winh yuj Dios yik snachajel jantak sk'ayb'ub'al heb' aj Babilonia chi' yuj heb' winh yet' tas tz'ib'ab'il. Haxo winhaj Daniel chi', ay pax sjelanil winh snaanel tas syalelk'och juntzanh wayich yet' juntzanh tas tz'ak'ji yila'.
Haxo yik ix k'och stiempoal icha yalnakkan winh rey, ix molb'aj masanil heb' winh kelemtak ix k'ay chi' yuj winhaj Aspenaz, ix yik'anb'at heb' winh winh t'a yichanh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix lolon winh yet' heb' winh, palta ha t'a skal heb' winh kelemtak chi' smasanil, malaj junok heb' winh syal slajb'an sb'a yet' heb' winh chanhwanh chi', haton winhaj Daniel, winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías. Yuj chi' ix ak'jikanoch heb' winh yak' serwil winh rey chi'.

Juntakel sk'anb'ej razón winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yuj juntzanh jelanil yet' tastak ajaltak snachajeli, ix nachajel yuj heb' winh, lajunhel wal ek'to sjelanil spensar heb' winh chanhwanh chi' t'a yichanh masanil heb' ajchum yet' heb' naumel lolonel ay t'a yol masanil smakb'en winh.
Haxo winhaj Daniel chi' ix kannhej winh t'a yopisio chi', masanto t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal.
Ayik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal, ay jun tas ix ak'ji swayichej winh. Ix te och winh ilk'olal yuj jun swayich chi', yuj chi' majxo ochlaj swayanh winh.

Haxo masanil heb' winh syal yuj yalani, heb' winh ajb'aal, heb' winh jelan yet' heb' winh schuman yet' k'een k'anal, ix chekji awtajkot heb' winh yuj winh rey chi', yik tzul yal heb' winh tas syalelk'och jun swayich winh chi'. Haxo yik ix jawi heb' winh t'a yichanh winh,
ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ay wal jun tas ix in wayichej, te ilk'olal waj yuj. Tzin nib'ej swojtakejeli tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh t'a ti' arameo icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab'nhej opisio tik t'a junelnhej. Al t'ayonh a onh a chekab' onh tik tas ix a wayichej chi', ol kalan t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Toxo ix in na'a, tato manh ol eyal t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, chok' ol ex aj he xikjichamok, haxo he pat, ol pojchajkanemok.

Palta tato ol eyal t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, niwan silab' ol wak' spakok t'ayex, te niwan pax ol aj eyelk'ochi. Yuj chi', alek t'ayin tas ix in wayichej chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh jelan chi' t'a schaelal icha tik: --Mamin rey, al a wayich chi' t'ayonh a onh a chekab' onh tik yik ol kal t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Wojtakxo to tonhej tze say modo tas tz'aj he kolan he b'a, yuj chi' tzeyik'ek' tiempo, yujto eyojtak to a tas ix wal t'a he patik manh ol ek'laj.

Tato manh ol eyala' tas ix in wayichej chi', a tas nab'il wuj t'a eyib'anh, ol ujok, yujto ix he mol alej tas tzeyutej he pakan t'ayin t'a esal, yakb'an wan he tanhwan in k'exan tas nab'il wuj t'a he patik. Alek tas ix in wayichej chi', yik snachajel wuuj to ol yal eyalani tas syalelk'ochi, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wixi heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, malaj junok anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik syal snachajel yuj tas tza k'anb'ej tik. Hanhejtona', malaj junok rey wach'chom te b'inajnak sk'anb'an icha jun tik t'a heb' winh jelan.
Yujto a jun tik, te ajaltak snachajeli. Malaj junok mach syal yalani, anhej am heb' Dios snachaj yuj, palta a heb' chi', manhok t'a ko kal ay heb' a onh anima onh tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winh rey icha chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il. Ix yalan winh to xikjicham heb' winh jelan chi' t'a masanil yol yik Babilonia.
Ayik ix elta jun ley chi', ix saychajek' winhaj Daniel yet' heb' winh oxwanh yetb'eyum winh, yik schampax heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Arioc, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' stanhwumal winh rey. Ix ak'jioch yopisio winh yik smilancham masanil heb' winh jelan chi'. Wan smolb'aj heb' winh yuj winh, haxo winhaj Daniel chi' ix lolon yet' winh t'a jelanil yet' t'a emnakilal.
Ix sk'anb'an yab' winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj elanhchamel ix yak'elta jun ley te ow tik winh rey chi'? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Arioc tas yaji.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Daniel yik stewi winh t'a winh rey yik tz'ak'ji jab'okxo stiempo winh, yik syalan winh tas syalelk'och jun wayich chi'. Ix scha sk'ol winh rey tas ix yal winh chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'atxi winhaj Daniel chi' t'a spat. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yetb'eyum, haton winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías, chajtil yaj jun lolonel chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh to sk'an skolwal sDiosal satchanh heb' winh yik snachajel jun lolonel satub'tak chi' yuj heb' winh, yik max miljicham heb' winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh jelan t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'.
Haxo t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix yak' Dios swayichej winhaj Daniel tas jun swayich winh rey chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi. Yuj chi', ix yal wach' lolonel winh t'a sDiosal satcha'anh.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach ko Diosal, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo, yujto ik yaj masanil jelanil yet' poder.
Ha ach ojtak jantak tiempo syak' yajalil junjun mach, yujto a ach tzak'och heb' t'a yopisio. Hanheja' a ach syal ik'anxiel heb'. Uuj ay spensar heb' ay spensar. Uuj ay sjelanil heb' jelan.
Ha ach tzak' ojtakajel tas satub'tak yet' tas k'ub'eltak yaji. Ojtak masanil tastak ay t'a kal k'ik' k'inal, yujto aj sakil k'inal ach.

Ach ko Diosal, sDiosal ach pax heb' ko mam kicham, skak' yuj diosal t'ayach. Skalanpax wach' lolonel, yujto ix ak' in jelanil yet' in tek'anil. Ha tiknaik, ix ak' wojtakejeli tas ix ko k'an t'ayach. Ix ak' kojtakejeli tas yaj swayich winh rey, xchi winh t'a Dios.

Ayik ix lajwi slesalwi winhaj Daniel chi', ix b'at winh t'a winhaj Arioc, haton winh ix ak'ji yopisio yik smilancham masanil heb' winh jelan t'a Babilonia chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Manh a milcham heb' winh jelan chi'. Ik' in b'at t'a yichanh winh rey. Ol wala' tas syalelk'och swayich winh chi', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' t'a elanhchamel ix ik'chajb'at winh yuj winhaj Arioc chi' t'a yichanh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Arioc chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' ik'b'ilkot t'a Judá, ix ilchaj jun winh winak wuuj. Ha winh ol alanok tas syalelk'och a wayich chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Daniel chi', skuchanpax Beltsasar, icha tik: --¿Ol am yal halani tas ix in wayichej chi', tas pax syalelk'ochi? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, a jun tas satub'tak tza nib'ej tzojtakejel chi', wach'chom a heb' winh jelan, heb' winh schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' winh ajb'aal, malaj junok heb' winh snachajel yuj.
Palta ay jun Dios ay t'a satcha'anh, ha' syal yak'an kojtakejel tas satub'tak. Ha ix ak'an ojtakejeli tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh. Ha tiknaik ol wal t'ayach tas ix a wayichej chi'.
Ach Mamin rey, ayik jichan ach ek' t'a sat ch'at, wan a naani tastak ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh, haxo Dios, haton tz'ak'an ojtakajel tas satub'tak, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayach.
Hanheja' pax ix ch'oxan jun tik t'ayin, manh yujok to te jelan in t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima, maay, palta yuj wak'an ojtakejeli tas syalelk'och a wayich chi', yik ol nachajel uuj tas tza na'a.
Mamin rey, a tas ix il t'a a wayich chi' to ay jun yechel anima te niwan, linhanek' t'a ichanh. Weei yilji, te ay smay yilji.
Ha sjolom, nab'a oro. Haxo snhi' sk'ool yet' sk'ab', nab'a plata. Haxo sk'ool yet' yib'tak xub', nab'a bronce.
Haxo xub' yet' spenek, nab'a hierro, haxo samil yok yet' yiximal yok, a k'een hierro kalan yaj yet' lum lum mukb'il t'a kal k'ak'.

Mamin rey, yakb'an wan ilan jun chi', ay jun k'een k'een munil ix kot t'a sat witz, malaj mach ix ekankot k'een. Ha wal t'a yok jun yechel chi' b'aj kalan yaj k'een hierro yet' lum lum, hata' ix och tanhnaj k'een.

nhej wal chi' ix pojb'at k'een hierro yet' lum lum chi', k'een bronce, k'een plata yet' k'een oro chi', pokokxonhej ix ajkanb'ati. Icha wal smatz'il ixim trigo b'aj stek'chaj t'a waresma tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik', manhxa jab'ok skani, icha chi' ix ajkanb'at jun yechel chi'. Haxo k'een k'een ix mak'anpoj jun yechel chi', ix q'uib'chaanh k'een. Icha lum niwak witz ix aj k'een, ix makchajel yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj k'een.
Mamin rey, haton jun tik ix a wayichej. Ha tiknaik ol wal t'ayach tas syalelk'ochi.
Ha ach tik, sat aj t'a masanil heb' rey, yujto ha Dios aj satcha'anh, ha' ix ach ak'anoch reyal. Ix yak'anpax a jelanil yet' a b'inajnakil yet' sniwanil elk'ochi.

Ix ach yak'och yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil lum lum b'aj kajan heb' anima, nok' nok' yet' nok' much. Ha Dios chi' ix ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yol a k'ab', yuj chi' a ach ton tzach sch'ox sjolom jun yechel to nab'a oro ix il chi'.

Ayik ol lajwokek' opisio tik, ol k'e waan junxo nación, palta manh lajanoklaj yet' jun ik tik. Slajwi chi', ol k'e waan junxo yoxil, haton jun sch'ox k'een bronce chi'. Haton jun chi' ol ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ol lajwok chi', ol k'e waan junxo schanhil te ay yip, icha k'een hierro. Ha k'een hierro chi' smak'an poj masanil tastak, pokok tz'aj yuj k'een. Icha chi' ol aj junxo ol k'e waan chi', ol satjokel juntzanhxo nación yuj.

Ix ilanpax yok yet' yiximal yok jun yechel chi', kalan yaj k'een hierro chi' yet' lum lum mukb'il t'a skal k'ak'. Ha jun chi' syalelk'ochi to a jun nación chi' cha makan yaji: Jun makan ay jab'ok yip icha k'een hierro, icha ix aj ilan k'een hierro kalan yaj yet' lum lum chi'.
Ha yiximal yok kalan yaj yet' k'een hierro yet' lum lum chi', a jun chi', syalelk'ochi to a jun nación chi' ay jab'ok yip, haxo nanhalxo malaj wal yip.

Icha wal ix aj ilan k'een hierro kalan yet' lum lum chi', icha chi' ol yutej sb'a heb' yajal t'a juntzanh nación chi'. Ol laj yik'laj sb'a yal yuninal heb' yik junnhej ol yutok sb'a heb' yalani, palta manh ol elk'ochlaj tas sna heb' chi', icha k'een hierro max skalej sb'a yet' lum lum.

Ha t'a stiempoal juntzanh heb' yajal chi', hata' ol k'e waan junxo nación yuj Dios aj satcha'anh, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol satelok, manhxo ol kan t'a yalanh junokxo. Ol satjokel juntzanhxo nación chi' yuj, ol kannhej t'a junelnhej.

Haton chi' syalelk'och k'een k'een ix il skot t'a sat witz to malaj junok mach ix ekankoti. Haton yuj k'een pokokxonhej ix ajkanb'at k'een hierro, k'een bronce, lum lum, k'een plata yet' k'een oro. Mamin rey, ha Dios te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' ix ch'oxan t'ayach tas ol ujok t'a b'ak'uinh chi'. Ha jun a wayich chi' te yel, icha wal tz'aj walan tik, icha chi' ol aj yelk'ochi, xchi winhaj Daniel t'a winh rey chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix em kumnaj winh t'a yichanh winhaj Daniel chi', ichato chi' ix schekan winh ak'chaj silab' yet' incienso t'a winh.

Ix yalanpax winh t'a winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Wal yel a he Diosal a ex tik, anhej yelxo niwan t'a yichanh juntzanhxo Dios. Haton wal yajalil heb' rey, a sch'oxanpax tas satub'tak yaji. Tik wal a achnhej ix nachajel jun lolonel tik uuj, xchi winh.

Haxo winh rey chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Daniel chi' t'a jun opisio te niwan yelk'ochi. Ix ak'chajpax silab' te wach' t'a winh, yuj chi' ix ak'chajoch winh yajalil t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'. Ix ochpax winh yajalil t'a masanil heb' winh jelan t'a smakb'en chi'.

Ix sk'an yopisio juntzanhxo heb' winh yetb'eyum winhaj Daniel t'a winh rey chi'. Ix schaan sk'ol winh rey chi', ix och heb' winh yajalil t'a yol yik Babilonia chi', haton winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego. Haxo winhaj Daniel chi', ha t'a sdespacho winh rey chi' ayoch winh t'a yopisio.
Ix schek winhaj rey Nabucodonosor b'ochaj jun yechel ayoch oro t'ay, 30 metro steel, haxo sat, oxe' metro. Ix yalan winh to tz'ak'jiem t'a jun ak'lik skuchan Dura t'a yol yik Babilonia chi'.

Ayik toxo ix b'oel jun yechel chi', ix yawtankot heb' winh ayoch yajalil winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en, haton heb' winh yajalil soldado, heb' winh gobernador, heb' winh ak'um razón t'a yoltak chonhab', heb' winh molum tumin, heb' winh juez yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil. Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a juntzanh heb' winh niwak yajal chi' t'a yichanh jun yechel chi', yik tz'och sq'uinh yuj heb' winh.
Ha jun mach ayoch t'a yib'anh sloloni, te chaanh ix aj yalani: Ab'ek he masanil ex anima ix ex kot t'a masanil chonhab' yet' t'a junjun nación yet' t'a junjun ti'al.

Ayik ol eyab'an sk'e sjaj masanil son tik, haton flauta, tanhb'il, arpa, salterio, zamponia yet' masanil juntzanhxo son, ol ex em kumnaj he masanil t'a yichanh jun niwan yechel ix schek b'ojok winhaj rey Nabucodonosor tik.
Masanil mach manh ol em kumnaj ejmelal t'a jun yechel tik, elanhchamel ol yumchajb'at t'a yol jun horno nhilnhon sk'e sk'ak'al, xchi.
Yuj chi', masanil anima ayek' molan chi', ayik ix yab'an heb' sk'e nhilnaj son chi', ix em kumnaj heb', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a jun yechel chi'.
Ha t'a yik chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh aj Caldea ix ul ak'an queja heb' winh aj Judá t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab' opisio t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha ach ix ala' to ayik sk'e sjaj masanil son tik, tz'em kumnaj masanil anima ejmelal t'a yichanh jun niwan yechel tik,
haxo mach max k'anab'ajani, syumchajb'at t'a yol horno sk'e nhilnhon sk'ak'al, xa chi.

Palta ay juntzanh heb' winh aj Judá, haton winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego, heb' winh ix ak'och yopisio t'a yol smakb'en Babilonia tik, maj sk'anab'ajej heb' winh tas ix ala'. Max och heb' winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh a diosal, max empax kuman heb' winh t'a jun yechel a diosal ix a chek b'ochajk'e tik, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il, ix schekan winh ik'chajkot heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh,
ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tom yel a ex tik Sadrac, Mesac yet' Abed-nego maj ex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh in diosal yet' t'a yechel in diosal ix in chek b'ochajk'e tik?

Ha tiknaik jun, tato b'ekan he k'ool, ayik ol eyab'an sk'e sjaj son chi' junelxo, ol ex och ejmelal t'a yichanh jun yechel ix in chek b'ochajk'e tik, malaj tas ol ex ik'anok. Tato max he k'anab'ajej eyem kuman ejmelal jun, a wal t'a jun rato chi', ol ex yumchajb'at t'a yol jun horno nhilnhon sk'e sk'ak'al. Tato icha chi' ol ex utajok, ¿machto junok Dios ol yal ex skolanel t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey, malaj tas wach' kalan yuj jun tik.
Ha ko Diosal b'aj tzonh och ejmelal a onh tik, syal onh skolanel t'a skal k'ak' t'a horno chi'. A' ol onh kolanel t'a yol a k'ab'.
Wach'chom manh ol onh koljok yuj jun, palta mamin rey skak' ojtakejeli to manh ol onh em kuman t'a juntzanh a diosal chi' yet' t'a jun yechel a diosal ix a chek b'ojok tik, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an juntzanh slolonel heb' winh kelemtak winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix chakb'i wal sat winh skot yowal. Ix schekan ekchajk'e sk'ak'al jun horno chi' winh, masanto jantak stechaj schakb'i sik'lab'il.
Ix schekan juntzanh heb' winh soldado winh te ay yip, yik stzek'chaj heb' winh oxwanh chi', syumchajb'at heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' t'a yol horno chi'.
Ha heb' winh oxwanh chi' ayto och spichul heb' winh sk'an t'a yopisio b'aj ayochi, ix tzek'chaj heb' winh yik syumchajb'at heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' t'a yol horno chi'.

Snib'ej winh rey chi' to elanhchamel syumjiem heb' winh t'a yol horno chi', yuj chi' ayik ix yumjiem heb' winh yuj heb' winh soldado chi', ix k'eul kopnaj te' k'ak' chi' t'a heb' winh soldado chi', ix cham heb' winh yujto te ow sk'ak'al.
Haxo pax heb' winh oxwanh chi', tzek'b'il heb' winh ix emk'och heb' winh t'a yol horno chi'.

T'a elanhchamel ix k'e juknaj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix xiwk'e winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yajal ayek' ta': --¿Tom manh oxwanhoknhej heb' winh kelemtak tzek'b'il ix yumjikanem t'a skal k'ak' chi'? xchi winh. --Ichaton chi' mamin rey, xchi heb' winh.

--Palta chanhwanh heb' winh swila', tijanel heb' winh, sb'eyek' heb' winh t'a skal k'ak' chi', malaj wal jab'ok tas tz'ik'an heb' winh. Haxo jun schanhil chi', lajan wal yilji icha junok Dios, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a winh t'a slak'anil sti' horno chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Sadrac, Mesac yet' ach Abed-nego, schekab' ex Dios Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, elanhekkoti, tzex kot t'a tik, xchi winh. Ix elta heb' winh yoxwanhil t'a kal k'ak' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och umnaj masanil heb' winh yajal t'a yol jun nación chi' yet' heb' winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey yil heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi', malaj wal jab'ok sniwanil heb' winh ix tz'a yuj k'ak' chi'. Ix chamwal yilan heb' winh to malaj jab'ok xil sjolom heb' winh ix tz'ai, malaj pax jab'ok spichul heb' winh ix tz'ai, malaj wal jab'ok sjab' te' k'ak' chi' t'a heb' winh.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' icha tik: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a sDiosal winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego to a ix chekankot yángel yik skoljiel heb' schekab' syak' wal och sk'ool t'ay. Maj sk'anab'ajej in cheknab'il a in rey in tik heb' winh, b'ekan sk'ol heb' winh scham t'a yichanhpax yem kuman t'a yalnhej tas diosal to manh sDiosalok heb' winh.

Ha tiknaik a in swala' to yalnhej mach anima sb'uchwaj t'a sDiosal winhaj Sadrac, winhaj Mesac yet' winhaj Abed-nego tik, chok' tz'aj heb' schami. Haxo spat heb' sjuchajem smasanil, wach'chom tas chonhab'il, tas nacional, ma tas ti'al syala', yujto malaj junokxo Dios syal skolwaj icha sDiosal heb' winh tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anoch heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi' winh rey t'a niwak opisio t'a smakb'en Babilonia chi'.

Ix yak'anb'at jun ab'ix winh rey t'a yol masanil smakb'en icha tik: Ha in rey Nabucodonosor in tik, swak' stzatzil he k'ool he masanil ex chonhab', ma ex nación yalxonhej tas ti'al tzeyala', a ex masanil ex kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
In gana tzeyojtakejel he masanil tastak satub'tak ix sk'ulej Dios Niwan Yelk'och t'ayin.
Te satub'takxonhej tas sk'ulej, manh jantakok spoder, Yajal ton t'a masanil tiempo, a yopisio malaj slajwub'.
Ha in Nabucodonosor in tik, tzalajk'olal wajek' t'a in palacio.
Palta ha t'a jun ak'wal, ay jun tas ix in wayichej. Ha yuj tas ix wil chi' yet' tas ix in na'a, ix in te xiwi.
Yuj chi' ix in chek awtajkot masanil heb' jelan t'a Babilonia tik, yik syalan heb' tas syalelk'och in wayich chi'.
Ix jawi heb' smasanil: Haton heb' ajb'aal, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' ajchum. Ix walan in wayich chi' t'a heb', palta maj yal-laj heb' t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi.
Stzak'anilxo ix jawi winhaj Daniel, skuchan pax Beltsasar, icha sb'i in diosal, ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'a winh. Ix walan in wayich chi' t'a winh icha tik:

Ach Beltsasar, yajal aj t'a skal heb' jelan spensar, wojtak to ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, ojtakpax masanil tas satub'tak. Scham wal ab'ani tas ix wil t'a in wayich, ol halan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi.
Haton wal in wayich ix wil tik ayik jichan in ek' in wayi: Ha t'a snanhal lum lum tik ix wil jun te te' te chaanh steel.
Ix q'uib'chaanh te', te niwan ix aj spatik te'. Ha schon te', ix k'ek'och t'a satcha'anh, chekel te' masanto b'aj slajwik'och lum lum.

Te wach' yilji xil te', manh jantakok sat te', k'okb'il wal syab' sat te' chi' sloan masanil anima. Haxo masanil nok' nok', tz'och nok' sk'ub'ej sb'a t'a yenhul yich te'. Haxo t'a sk'ab'tak te' sb'o so' nok' much, haxo masanil tas pitzan t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, k'okb'il swatzitaj heb' yuj sat te'.
Haxo ix aj jun, ix wilan jun ángel t'a in wayich chi', to stanhwej yol yib'anhk'inal tik, wan yemta t'a satcha'anh.

Te chaanh ix el yaw, ix yalan icha tik: Ch'akekel te te' chi', xikekel sk'ab' te', tzeyik'anel xil te', tze saklemanb'at sat te' chi' smasanil. Saklemokab'kanb'at masanil nok' nok' ayoch t'a yalanh yenhul te' yet' masanil nok' much ayoch t'a sk'ab'tak te'.

Haxonhej yib' te' tzeyaktejkani, tze tzek'ankan te' yib' chi' yet' k'een cadena to hierro yet' bronce. Skan jun chi' t'a skal anh ank'ultak chi', haxo yal ak'wal ol em t'a yib'anh, haxo anh ank'ultak ol sk'ux icha nok' kaltakte'al nok'.
Ol ixtaxel spensar. Lajanxo ol aj spensar icha spensar nok' nok'. Ha jun makan yaelal chi', uke' ab'il ol yak'a'.

Ha onh ángel onh sko tanhwej yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a onh skala' to ol jawok jun yaelal tik t'a yib'anh, yik wach' syojtakejel heb' anima smasanil to ha Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ay yopisio t'a yib'anhtak nación. Ha tz'ak'an opisio t'a mach snib'ej syak'ochi, syalpax yak'anoch junok mach emnakil yajalilok junok nación, xchi jun ángel chi'.

Haton in wayich ix wil tik. Ha tiknaik ach Beltsasar, al t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, yujto malaj wal junokxo heb' ay tas syal yuj t'a yol in makb'en tik snachajel yuj. Palta a ach tik ol yal snachajel uuj, yujto ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, xin chi.

Haxo winhaj Daniel chi', haton winh skuchpax Beltsasar, ken am manh junok hora ix kan numan winh. Ix somchajk'e spensar winh, palta ix walan t'a winh: Beltsasar, manh ak' pensar yuj jun in wayich chi' yet' tas syalelk'ochi, xin chi. Ix yalan winh t'ayin: Ay mamin rey, komonok wal t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach ol em tas syalelk'och jun a wayich tik.
Mamin rey, a jun te te' te chaanh steel ix il chi', haton jun te' ix k'ek'och t'a satcha'anh, te' ix cheklaj t'a najat,

te' wach' yilji xiil, te' tzijtum sat, te' k'okb'ilnhej syab' sat sloan masanil tas pitzan, te' b'aj tz'och masanil nok' nok' sk'ub'ej sb'a t'a yalanh yenhul sk'ab', te' b'aj sb'o so' nok' much t'a skaltak sk'ab',
a ach ton tik mamin rey. To ix ach k'enhejchaanh yuj sniwanil elk'och chi'. Ix k'ek'och a b'inajnakil t'a satcha'anh. Yajal ach t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ix ilanpax yemta jun ángel stanhwumal yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a satcha'anh, ix yalani: Ch'akek telwok te niwan te' chi', yik slajwiem te'. Haxonhej yib' te' yet' sch'anhal yib' tzeyak'kani. Stzek'chajkan yib' te' yet' k'een cadena to hierro yet' bronce, skan t'a kaltak ank'ultak. Emokab' yal ak'wal t'a yib'anh ta', ol kajnaj yet' nok' nok' ukeok ab'il.
Ha syalelk'och jun tik mamin rey, a jun Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' tz'alan jun tik t'a ib'anh.

Ol ach pechchajel t'a skal heb' anima tik. Ol ach b'atkan t'a skal nok' nok', haxo anh ank'ultak ol a k'ux icha nok' wakax. Ol em yal ak'wal t'a ib'anh. Mamin rey, icha chi' ol ach ajek' ukeok ab'il, masanto ol nachajel uuj to a jun Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' yajal yaj t'a yib'anh heb' anima. Ha tz'ak'anpaxoch heb' yajal icha snib'ej mach syak'ochi.
Ha jun lolonel ix alchaji to skan yib' te' yet' sch'anhal yib' chi', syalelk'ochi to ol ach k'ochxok t'a opisio chi' ayik toxo ix nachajel uuj to ha Dios yajal yaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Yuj chi' mamin rey, cha ab' masanil juntzanh lolonel swal tik t'ayach. Yuj chi' tojolnhej tzutej a b'a, manhxo ak'och a mul. Komonok wal tzaktejkan a k'ulan chukal, tzach kolwaj t'a heb' tz'ixtaji. Tato icha chi', tekan ol ach kan t'a junk'olal yet' a k'echaanh t'a masanil tasi, xchi winhaj Daniel chi' t'ayin, xchi winh rey Nabucodonosor chi'.
Masanil juntzanh lolonel ix alchaj t'a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix elk'ochi.
Yab'ilal yalchaj juntzanh chi' t'a winh rey chi', ayik wan sb'eyek' winh t'a spanhanil yib'anh spalacio t'a Babilonia,
ix yalan winh icha tik: Ina wal yilji niwan chonhab' Babilonia tik. Ha in yet' wal in poder ix in b'ok'ei yik scheklajeli to niwan welk'ochi, xchi winh.

Wanto wal yalan juntzanh lolonel chi' winh, ix yab'an winh yoch jun lolonel t'a satcha'anh, ix yalani: Scham ab'an juntzanh lolonel tik ach rey Nabucodonosor, a opisio chi', toxo ix ik'chajek' t'ayach.

Ol ach pechchajel t'a skal heb' anima, ol ach b'atkan t'a skal nok' nok'. Ha anh ank'ultak ol a k'ux ichok nok' nok' t'a ukeok ab'il, masanto ol yal snachajel uuj to ha Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' tz'ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil anima yet' t'a yib'anh masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. A' tz'ak'anoch t'a yajalil mach snib'ej syak'ochi, xchi jun lolonel chi'.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix elk'och tas alb'ilkan t'a yib'anh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi', ix pechchajkanel winh t'a skal heb' anima. Ha anh ank'ultak ix sk'ux winh icha nok' wakax, haxo yal ak'wal ix em t'a yib'anh sniwanil winh. Ix q'uib' xiil winh icha nok' ch'akb'a, hanheja' icha yech nok' ix aj k'een yech winh.

Ix yalanpaxb'at winh rey chi' icha tik: Ayik ix lajwi stiempoal yaelal ayoch t'a wib'anh a in Nabucodonosor in tik, ix in k'e k'elan t'a satcha'anh, ix b'o in pensar t'a in lokoal. Ix walan wach' lolonel t'a Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ix wik'anchaanh sb'i Jun aynhejek' t'a junelnhej: Yujto Yajal ton t'a junelnhej, a yopisio malaj slajwub'.

Ha t'a yichanh, malaj wal jab'ok tas syal yuj heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik. Sk'ulejnhej tas snib'ej t'a skal heb' ayek' t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a skal heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik. Malaj mach syal syamanoch waan sk'ab' syalan t'ay, ¿tas yuj icha chi' tza k'ulej? manh xchiok.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix meltzaj in pensar ix wab'i yet' wik'anxi wopisio niwan yelk'ochi yet' in poder. Haxo heb' in chekab' yet' heb' niwak yopisio t'a in despacho, ix jawi heb' ul in sayeq'ui. Ix in ochxi yajalil t'a in nación, ix yik'anxi yip wopisio. Te niwan ix ajxi t'a yichanh icha yaj t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ha tiknaik, a in wal swik'chaanh Jun sReyal satcha'anh. Swalanpax wach' lolonel t'ay, yujto a masanil tas sk'ulej, wach'nhej, tojolnhej t'a smasanil. Syalpax yik'anemta heb' syaloch sb'a to niwan yelk'ochi, xchib'at winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'.
Ha winhaj Belsasar sreyal Babilonia, ix yawtej mil heb' niwak yopisio winh t'a yol snación t'a jun niwan wael. Ha t'a jun wael chi', ix yuk' anh heb', ix yuk'an anh winh yet' heb'.

Wanxo sk'e anh t'a sjolom winh rey chi', ix schekan winh ik'chajkot kopa yet' uk'ab' nab'a oro, haton juntzanh yik'nakkot winhaj Nabucodonosor smam icham winh t'a templo t'a Jerusalén. Ha t'a yol juntzanh kopa yet' juntzanh uk'ab' ix b'at ik'chajkot chi', hata' ix yuk' anh winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum yet' pax masanil heb' ayoch yet' winh t'a wael chi'.
Masanil heb' ix cham yuj anh, ix yik'anchaanh sdiosal heb' nab'a oro, plata, bronce, hierro, te te' yet' k'een k'een.
Ha t'a jun rato chi', ix cheklaj jun k'ab' anima b'aj sakq'uinal yuj candil, ix och ijan stz'ib'anoch t'a sat pat chi'. Ayik ix yilan jun k'ab' stz'ib'an chi' winh rey,
sak ix aj sat winh yuj xiwelal. Ix luklonk'e yok winh, ix el wal yip winh.

Elanhchamel ix el yaw winh, ix yawtankot heb' naumel lolonel winh, heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' ajchum. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ha mach syal yilan juntzanh tz'ib'ab'iloch chi', syalan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, tz'ak'chajoch junok pichul púrpura t'ay, tz'ak'chajoch junok cadena oro t'a sjaj, tz'och t'a yoxil yajalil t'a in makb'en tik, xchi winh.
Masanil heb' jelan ayoch yopisio yak'an srazón winh rey chi', ix och heb' t'a yol jun cuarto, palta malaj wal junok heb' ix nachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi.
Ix te xiw winhaj rey Belsasar chi', sak ix aj yilji sat winh. Haxo masanil heb' winh winak ayek' yet' winh ta', ix somchajpax sk'ool heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an ix reina, snun winh rey chi' yel yaw winh yet' pax heb' awtab'il, ix och ix t'a yol scuartoal b'aj ayoch q'uinh chi', ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ayokab'nhej opisio t'a junelnhej. Mokab' ak' pensar, mokab' ach sakb'ielpax yuj xiwelal,

yujto ha t'a yol a makb'en tik, ay jun winh syal snachajel yuj, ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'a winh. Ha t'a yol stiempoal winh a mam icham, a jun winh winak chi', ix sch'ox wal winh to ay spensar winh te wach', ay spensar winh sik'lab'il icha yik heb' Dios. Yuj chi', a winhaj rey Nabucodonosor a mam icham, a winh ix ak'anoch jun winh chi' yajalilok heb' ay spensar, heb' naumel lolonel, heb' schuman yet' k'een k'anal yet' heb' ajchum.

Daniel sb'i jun winh chi', haxo winh a mam icham chi' ix ak'an skuch winh Beltsasar. Te ay sjelanil winh yet' tas yojtak, yik snachajel wayich yuj winh, syal snachajpaxel yuj winh tas syalelk'och junok lolonel to ajaltak snachajeli yet' sb'oan yaj junok tas to niwan yaji. Awtejkot winh an. Ha winh ol ak'an ojtakejel tas syalelk'och juntzanh tz'ib' t'a sat pat tik, xchi ix t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix awtaj winhaj Daniel chi', ix ik'chajb'at winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿A ach am tik tza kuch Daniel, aj Judá ik'b'ilkot preso yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor winh in mam icham?
Ix alchaj t'ayin tob' ayoch sjelanil juntzanh Dios t'ayach, tob' ay a pensar, jelan ach.

Yuj chi' ix ach wawtej. Ix wawtej masanil heb' winh jelan yet' heb' naumel lolonel, yik syawtej juntzanh lolonel heb' tz'ib'ab'iloch tik yet' yalan heb' t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, palta malaj wal junok heb' snachajel yuj tas syalelk'ochi.

Ix alchaj t'ayin tob' syal ak'an cheklajel lolonel ajaltak snachajeli. Yuj chi' ta syal awtan juntzanh lolonel tik, tzalan t'ayin tas syalelk'ochi, ol ak'chajoch pichul púrpura t'ayach, ol ak'chajpaxoch junok cadena oro t'a a jaj, ol ach och t'a yoxil yajalil t'a yol in makb'en tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Kanokab' a silab' chi' t'ayach mamin rey. Syal ak'an jun opisio chi' t'a junokxo, palta ol wawtej jun tz'ib' tik, ol walan t'ayach tas wal syalelk'och juntzanh lolonel tz'ib'ab'iloch t'a sat pat tik.
Mamin rey, ha Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ha' ix ak'an yopisio winhaj Nabucodonosor a mam icham yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi, sb'inajnakil yet' stzikikial.

Yuj opisio ix ak'chaj chi' t'a winh, ix xiw masanil anima t'a junjun nación yet' t'a junjun ti'al, yujto niwan yelk'och winh rey chi' t'a yol sat heb'. Ha mach snib'ej winh schami, schamnhej, haxo mach malaj snib'ej winh schami, max miljichamok. Ay pax mach ix ik'jiel t'a yopisio yuj winh, ay pax mach ix ak'jioch t'a yopisio, hato ha' tas snib'ej sk'ool winh.
Palta a wal yik ix yik'anchaanh sb'a winh, ix ixtaxel sb'eyb'al winh. Ix ik'chajel winh t'a yopisio t'a reyal chi' yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi.

Ix pechchajel winh t'a skal heb' yetanimail, ix ochkan spensar winh icha spensar nok' nok'. Junnhej ix aj winh yet' nok' kaltakte'al b'uru. Ix sk'ux anh ank'ultak winh icha nok' wakax. Ix empax yal ak'wal t'a sniwanil winh, masanto ix yal snachajel yuj winh chajtil wal yaj Dios, Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, yajal pax yaj t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha tz'ak'anoch heb' yajal to snib'ej syak'ochi.
Ha hachxo pax tik, mamin rey Belsasar, yixchikin ach winh, wach'chom ojtak tas ix uji chi', palta manh wal jab'ok tzik'em a b'a.

Palta yelxo ix ik'chaanh a b'a t'a yichanh Jun Yajalil satcha'anh. Ix ak'an ik'chajkot juntzanh kopa t'a a mexa yet' juntzanh uk'ab' yik stemplo Jun Yajal satcha'anh chi'. Ha t'a yol juntzanh chi' ix uk' wino yet' masanil heb' awtab'il uuj. Ix eyik'chaanh juntzanh Dios to max yal yilani, max yal yab'ani, malaj pax jab'ok tas yojtak. Manhok pax t'a Dios ix al wach' lolonel, ina a pax t'a yol sk'ab' ay a k 'inal, a pax snaan tas tza k'ulej.
Yuj chi' ix yak'kot Dios jun k'ab' ix tz'ib'an juntzanh lolonel tik,
MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPARSIN.
Ha juntzanh tik icha tik syalelk'ochi: MENE: Toxo ix sb'is Dios jaye' k'u ayachto och t'a opisio, toxo ix sch'ox slajwub'.
TEKEL: Toxo ix ach echtaj t'a yol echlab', manh tz'akanok alil.
PERES: Ha a makb'en, wan spojchajb'ati, ix ak'chajoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' Medo yet' heb' Persa, xchi winhaj Daniel chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winhaj rey Belsasar chi' ak'chajoch pichul púrpura t'a winhaj Daniel chi'. Ix ak'chajoch jun cadena nab'a oro t'a sjaj winh. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a masanil anima to ha t'a jun rato chi', ix ochkan winhaj Daniel chi' t'a yoxil yajalil t'a yol smakb'en.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix miljicham winhaj Belsasar sreyal heb' caldeo chi'.
Haxo winhaj Darío aj Media ix yak'och sb'a yajalil sk'exulok winh. 62 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Darío chi'.
Ix yak'anoch 120 heb' winh gobernador winhaj Darío chi', yik syil junjun makan chonhab' heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en.

Ix yak'anoch oxwanhxo sat yajal winh t'a heb' winh gobernador chi', yik syilan heb' winh yet' stanhwan masanil tastak, yik wach' tz'akan tz'aj yak'chaj k'een tumin syak' heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. T'a skal heb' winh sat yaj chi' ayoch winhaj Daniel chi'.
Ix cheklajel winhaj Daniel chi' t'a skal heb' winh yetyajalil chi', yujto wach'nhej syutej sb'a winh. Yuj chi' ix sna winh rey chi' to tz'och winh sat yajalil t'a yol smakb'en chi'.

Haxo juntzanh heb' winh yetyajalil winh chi', ix say modo heb' winh tas tz'aj yemta winh t'a yopisio chi'. Palta te k'anab'ajum winh, max elk'an winh t'a tas sk'ulej, ayoch spensar winh t'a yopisio chi'. Yuj chi' malaj junok tas syal yalank'e heb' winh t'a spatik winh.
Yuj chi' ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh snaani, ix yalan heb' winh: Malaj wal junok tas syal kalank'e t'a spatik winh, anhej yuj sk'anab'ajan sDiosal winh, xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix slajtiej sb'a heb' winh yajal chi', yik b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Darío chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin rey Darío, ayokab'nhej opisio t'a junelnhej.

Ix ko mol lajtiej ko b'a ko masanil a onh yajal onh tik t'a yol a makb'en tik. Ix ko naani to tzak'elta junok ley yik tz'alchajel t'a skal masanil anima t'a masanil yol a makb'en tik to malaj junok mach sk'anan skolwal sdiosal, ma t'a junokxo yetanimail t'a junok ujal, palta anhej t'ayach syal sb'a mamin rey. Ha mach max k'anab'ajan jun ley chi', tojolnhej syumjikanem b'aj makb'il nok' choj.
Yuj chi', mamin rey, ak' tz'ib'chaj jun ley chi', tzak'anoch a sello t'ay yik wach' malaj mach syal sk'exani. A' ko ley a onh medos yet' persas onh tik, max yal-laj yek'b'ati, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey Darío chi' tz'ib'chaj jun ley chi', ix yak'anoch winh t'a yopisio.

Haxo ix yab'an winhaj Daniel to toxo ix alchajel jun ley chi', ix k'enhej winh t'a yol spat t'a chaanh, ix sjakanxi swentena winh k'elanb'at t'a stojolal Jerusalén. Ix em kuman winh, ix lesalwi winh t'a Dios, ix yak'an yuj diosal winh t'ay. Oxel slesalwi winh t'a junjun k'u, ichataxon sk'ulej winh.
Haxo juntzanh heb' winh chi', ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh to wan slesalwi winh yet' stewi winh t'a Dios.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ix b'at yalan heb' winh yuj jun ley toxo ix alchajel chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Toton ix a chek alchajel jun ley tz'alan icha tik: Yalnhej mach syal sb'a t'a sdiosal, ma t'a junokxo ch'ok animail t'a junok ujal, tato manhok t'a winh rey syal tas snib'ej, yowalil syumchajem b'aj makb'il nok' choj, xchi. ¿Manh am yelok icha chi'? xchi heb' winh. --Ichaton chi' ix aji. Ha jun ley chi' yowalil sk'anab'ajaji, a ko leyal a onh medos yet' persas onh tik, max yal-laj yek'b'at tas syala', xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh yalan icha tik: --Ha winhaj Daniel, winh ik'chajnakkot t'a Judá, max sk'anab'ajejlaj winh. Mamin rey, manh jab'ok xiw winh t'ayach, malaj pax jab'ok yelk'och jun ley chi' t'a winh. Toxo ix kila' to oxel slesalwi winh t'a sDiosal t'a junjun k'u, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winh rey chi' icha chi', ix och winh t'a kusk'olal. Masanil jun k'ual chi', ix sayek' winh tas tz'aj skolchajel winhaj Daniel chi'.

Haxo yik wanxo sb'at k'u, ix smolb'anxi sb'a juntzanh heb' winh winak chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh: --Mamin rey, ojtak wal to a ko ley a onh medos yet' persas onh tik, ta ay junok lolonel, ma junok ley toxo ix yalel winh rey, maxtzak yal-laj yek'b'ati, xchi heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winh rey chi' ik'chajkot winhaj Daniel chi' yik syumchajem winh b'aj makb'il nok' choj chi'. Ayik manto yumchajem winh, ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Komonok wal ol ach koljok yuj a Diosal to ayachnhejoch ak'an serwil, xchi winh.

Ayik toxo ix yumjikanem winh t'a skal nok' choj chi', ix ak'jikanem jun k'een k'een smakulok. Ix ak'jikanoch sello yik yopisio winh rey chi' t'a k'een yet' sello heb' winh niwak yajal yaj yet' winh, yik wach' max tenjiek' tas ix alchaj t'a spatik winhaj Daniel chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh rey chi' t'a spalacio, palta majxo walaj winh, majxo schek winh ik'chajkot heb' tz'ak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ool. Ix b'at way winh, palta junelnhej maj ochlaj swayanh winh t'a jun ak'wal chi'.
Ix pet k'e waan winh, ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a sti' b'aj makb'il nok' choj chi'.

Ayik ix k'och winh t'a slak'anil chi', ix awaj winh t'a winhaj Daniel chi'. Kuseltak ix yutej awaj sb'a winh, ix yalan winh: --Daniel, ach schekab' jun Dios pitzan, haton jun Dios tzak'nhej serwil ¿ix am yal ach skolanel a Diosal t'a nok' choj chi'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Daniel chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ayokab' opisio t'a junelnhej.

Ix schekkot jun yángel in Diosal yik smakan sti' nok' choj tik. Yuj chi' malaj wal jab'ok tas ix in yutej nok', yujto yojtak to malaj jab'ok in mul t'a yichanh. Malaj pax tas chuk ix in k'ulej t'ayach, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix te tzalajk'e winh rey chi', ix schekan winh ik'chajk'eta winhaj Daniel b'aj ay nok' choj chi'. Haxo yik ix k'eul winh, ix yilan heb' to malaj jab'ok b'aj ix lajwi winh, yujto a sDiosal winh ayoch yipok sk'ool.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' to sb'at ik'jikot heb' winh ix alank'e jun lolonel t'a spatik winhaj Daniel chi'. Ix yumjikanem heb' winh t'a skal nok' choj chi' yet' yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal junjun heb' winh. Manto emk'ochlaj heb' t'a skal nok', ix k'eta tzakaljok nok' t'a heb', chok' ix aj heb' yuj nok'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an tz'ib'chaj winhaj rey Darío jun tik t'a masanil anima yalnhej tas ti'al ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Junk'olalokab' eyaji.

Swalan t'ayex he masanil t'a yol in makb'en, niwanokab' yelk'och sDiosal winhaj Daniel t'a yol he sat. Yujto a sDiosal winh chi', pitzan toni, aynhejek' t'a junelnhej. Ha yopisio, malaj b'ak'uinh ol satelok, malaj slajwub'.
Ha Jun Kolwajum chi', a skolan heb' yik yet' spoder. Sch'oxan tas satub'tak t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik. Ha ix kolanel winhaj Daniel t'a nok' choj, xchib'at winh rey chi'.
Aynhejoch winhaj Daniel chi' t'a yopisio ayik ayoch winhaj Darío t'a reyal yet' pax yik ayoch winhaj Ciro aj Persia reyal.

Ha t'a yik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Belsasar reyal t'a Babilonia, ay jun ak'wal, ay juntzanh tas ix ak'ji wil a in Daniel tik t'a in wayich. Haxo ix in k'e waan, ix in tz'ib'an tastak niwan yelk'och t'a in wayich chi'. Haton juntzanh tik ix in tz'ib'ejkani:
Ix wil t'a in wayich to ha t'a schanh pak'anhil yol yib'anhk'inal, ix kot ponhnaj ik' t'a yib'anh ha ha', ix ib'xik'e ha' niwan mar chi' yuj.
Haxo ix aji, ix cheklajk'e chanhwanh nok' niwak nok' t'a yol ha' mar chi', ch'okch'ok yilji junjun nok'.

Ha jun nok' ix b'ab'laj k'euli, lajan yilji nok' icha nok' choj, palta ay sk'axil nok' icha yik nok' t'iw. Ayik wan wilan nok' chi', ix jekchitajel sk'axil nok' chi'. Ix ak'chajk'e linhan t'a sat lu'um, icha tz'ajk'e linhan anima ix ajk'ei. Ix k'exwi spensar, icha spensar anima ix aji.

Haxo nok' schab'il, lajan yilji nok' icha nok' oso, tz'eyank'e jun pak'anh sniwanil nok' t'a yichanh junxo pak'anh. Ha t'a yol sti' nok', ay oxe' b'akil kostil. Ix wab'an yalchaj t'a nok': Ixik, tza chi'an jantak chib'ej snib'ej a k'ool, xchi t'a nok'.
Haxo nok' yoxil, lajan yilji nok' icha nok' tz'ib'choj. Ay chanhe' sk'axil nok' t'a snanhal yich spatik. Ix wilanpaxi to ay chanhe' sjolom nok', ix ak'chaj spoder nok' yak'an yajalil.

Haxo nok' schanhil ix wil t'a in wayich chi', te chuklaj yilji nok'. Te ay smay kilan nok', te ay yip nok'. Te niwak k'een ye nok', nab'a hierro. Chok' tz'aj masanil tas yuj nok', sb'uk'anem nok', haxo jantakto skan yuj nok', stek'kanem nok'. Yelxo te ch'ok yilji jun nok' chi' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nok' ix wil t'a sb'ab'elal. Ay lajunhe' sch'aak nok'.

Yakb'an k'elan in och t'a juntzanh sch'aak nok' chi', ix wilani, ix k'eul junxo syune' ch'aak nok' t'a skal juntzanhxo chi'. Ayik ix k'eul junxo sch'aak nok' chi', ix stenankanel oxe' ch'aak aytaxon chi'. Haxonhej jun chi' ix kan sk'exulok juntzanh chi'. Ha jun ch'aak chi', ay yol sat yet' sti' icha yik anima, ix yik'chaanh sb'a yet' tas ix yala'.

Ix wilannhej, masanto ix ak'chajem juntzanh k'ojnub' yik heb' yajal, haxo Dios, Jun Aytaxoneq'ui, ix em k'ojan t'a sk'ojnub'. Te sak yilji spichul icha yilji k'een sakb'akom. Haxo xil sjolom, te sak yilji icha nok' saksak lana. Ha sk'ojnub' chi' yet' sruedail, ichato sk'e nhilnhon sk'ak'al.

Ay jun k'ak' tz'elta t'a yichanh icha sb'ey ha ha'. Ha heb' tz'ak'an serwil, linhanoch heb' t'a yichanh, millonalxo sb'isul heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix el yich sch'olb'itaj juntzanh nación, ix jakwi juntzanh ch'anh libro.

Q'uelan innhejoch yuj juntzanh b'uchwal lolonel wan yalan jun yune' ch'aak chi'. Yakb'an wan wilan chi', ix mak'jicham jun nok' chi'. Chok'xonhej ix aj nok', ix yumjib'at nok' t'a skal k'ak', ix tz'ab'at nok'.
Haxo juntzanhxo nok' chi', ix ik'chajek' yopisio nok', palta ixto chajiek' nok' jab'okxo.
Ix wilannhej t'a in wayich chi': Ix wilani to ay jun mach ix kot t'a skal asun, lajan yilji icha anima. Ix k'och b'aj ayek' Dios Jun Aytaxonek' chi', ix och t'a yichanh.
Ix ak'chaj yopisio, spoder yet' sniwanil yelk'ochi. Masanil anima, yalnhej tas ti'al tz'ak'an serwil. Ha spoder aynhejek' t'a junelnhej, malaj b'ak'uinh ol lajwok yopisio chi'.
Ix in xiwkank'ei ayik ix wilan juntzanh tik, ix somchaj in pensar yuj.
Ix in och t'a stz'ey junok linhanoch ta', ix in k'anb'an t'ay tas syalelk'och juntzanh chi'. Ix tak'wi t'ayin icha tik:
Ha chanhwanh nok' nok' ix il chi', haton chanhe' nación ol cheklajk'e t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ayik ol lajwokek' juntzanh nación chi', a heb' yikxo Dios, Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ol ak'jokkanoch heb' yajalil t'a junelnhej, manhxalaj b'ak'uinh ol ik'jokek' yopisio heb' chi', xchi.

Ix in k'anb'ejxi t'ay, tas yaj nok' schanhil nok' chi', te ch'ok yilji nok' t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nok' chi'. Nab'a hierro k'een ye nok', nab'a bronce yech nok'. Masanil tas chok' tz'aj yuj nok', sturanb'at nok', haxo jantakto skani, stek'kanem nok'.

Hanhejtona', ix in k'anb'ejpaxi tas syalelk'och lajunhe' sch'aak nok' chi' yet' junxo sch'aak nok' tzak'anto ix k'eul chi', jun ix tenanel oxexo ayik ix k'euli. Te niwan pax yelk'och t'a yichanh juntzanhxo ch'aak chi'. Ha jun toto ix k'eul chi', ay yol sat, ay pax sti', syalan b'uchwal lolonel.
Ix wilani to a jun ch'aak chi', syak' owal yet' heb' yikxo Dios. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj,
masanto ix k'och Dios, Jun Aytaxoneq'ui. Ix sb'oan yaj t'a heb', yujto ix k'och sk'ual schaan yopisio heb'.

Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Ha nok' schanhil chi', haton jun schanhil nación ol cheklajk'e t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ch'ok yel t'a yichanh juntzanhxo nación ol ek'ok. Ol smakek' masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yak'an yajalil t'a malaj yok'elk'olal.

Ha lajunhe' sch'aak chi', haton lajunhwanh heb' winh yajal. Ha heb' winh ol ak'an yajalil t'a lajunh makan yaj jun nación chi'. Ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh chi', ol k'e waan junxo rey te ch'ok yel t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh t'a sb'ab'elal chi', ol ik'jokel oxwanhok heb' winh rey chi' t'a yopisio yuj.

Ol te b'uchwaj t'a Dios Te Niwan Yelk'ochi, ol yixtejnhej heb' yikxo Dios chi'. Ol yak'lan sk'exan juntzanh ley yet' juntzanh q'uinh alb'ilkan yuj Dios. Ol ak'chajkan heb' yikxo Dios chi' t'a yol sk'ab' t'a nanhal schanhil ab'il.
Palta ayik ol jawok sk'ual, ol ch'olb'itajok, ol ik'chajel spoder chi', ol satel t'a junelnhej.

Haxo yajalil yet' spoder yet' sniwanil yelk'och juntzanh nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol ak'chaj t'a heb' yikxo Dios chi', haton Jun Te Niwan Yelk'ochi. Ha Dios ol ak'an yajalil t'a junelnhej. Masanil heb' ayoch yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik ol ak'an serwil, ol sk'anab'ajan heb' t'ay, xchi t'ayin.
Haton slajwub'al juntzanh tas ix alchajkan t'ayin a in Daniel in tik. Ix te somchaj in k'ool. Ix tup in chiq'uil yuj xiwelal, palta malaj junok mach b'aj ix wal juntzanh lolonel tik.
Ha t'a yoxil ab'il yoch winhaj Belsasar reyal, ay juntzanhxo tas ix ak'ji wila'', ayik toxo ix ak'ji wil juntzanh t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ha ix aj wilani, ichato ayinek' t'a chonhab' Susa, t'a yol yik Elam, t'a sti' ha' Ulai.
Haxo ix wilani, ay jun nok' ch'ak kalnel ayek' t'a sti' ha' chi'. Ay chab' sch'aak nok' niwak steel, palta ay jun sch'ak nok' chi' tzak'anto ix k'euli, te niwan steel t'a yichanh junxo chi'.

Haxo ix wilani, a yet' sch'ak jun nok' kalnel chi', ix yak' lajwok tastak ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' t'a norte yet' pax t'a sur. Malaj junokxo nok' syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a yichanh, malaj mach syal skolanelta sb'a t'a yol sk'ab'. Sk'ulejnhej tas snib'ej. Ix yik' wal chaanh sb'a.

Wanto in naan yuj tas ix wil chi', haxo ix wilani, ay jun nok' mam chiwa wan sjawi t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Yelk'olal skot nok', icha wal to max em jab'ok yok nok' t'a sat lu'um. Ha jun nok' chiwa chi', ay wal jun sch'aak nok' te chekel. Ha t'a skal yol sat nok' ayk'eta.
Ayik ix k'och nok' t'a slak'anil nok' kalnel chab' sch'aak chi', nok' ix wil t'a sti' ha ha', ix b'at juknaj nok' t'a nok' yet' jantak yowal sk'ool.

Ix smak'an kanhchaj sch'aak nok' kalnel chi' nok' schab'il. Manhxalaj yip nok' kalnel chi' yik stek'b'ej sb'a t'a yichanh nok' chiwa chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix telwi nok' yuj nok' chiwa chi' t'a sat lu'um, ix tek'jiem etzan nok' yuj nok'. Malaj mach ix yal skolan nok'.

Haxo nok' mam chiwa chi', ix ste wach' ik'ejchaanh sb'a nok'. Haxo ix aji, ayik te tek'an nok' chi', ix kanhchajb'at jun sch'aak nok' te niwan chi', haxo chanhexo sch'aak nok' ix k'eul sk'exulok jun chi'. Ayik ix k'eul sch'aak nok' chi', ix b'atkan k'elan junjun ch'aak chi' t'a stojolal schanhil pak'anh yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ha t'a junok juntzanh ch'aak chi', ix pak'elta junxo yune' ch'aak. Ha jun chi', te niwan ix aji yet' yipalil ix smak juntzanh lugar t'a sur yet' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix smakpax lum lum te nib'ab'il.
Yelxo te chaanh ix aj sq'uib'i, masanto ix k'ek'och b'aj ay k'een k'anal. Ix syumanemta jayeok k'een k'anal chi', ix stek'anem k'een t'a sat lu'um.
Ix stek'b'an sb'a t'a yichanh winh yajalil heb' ay t'a satcha'anh chi'. Ix skachanoch waan yak'chaj silab' tz'ak'ji t'a Dios t'a junjun k'u. Ix yixtanb'at b'aj tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'a Dios chi'.

Ha yuj schuk pensaril jun yajal chi', ix yak'och soldado b'aj tz'ak'jitaxon silab' t'a junjun k'u yet' skachjioch waan yak'ji silab' chi'. Ix satanel jun ejmelal wach' alb'ilkan yuj Dios. Ichato chi' b'ian ix sk'ulan tas snib'ej.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wab'ani to ay jun ángel sk'anb'an t'a junxo ángel icha tik: ¿Jantakto tiempo yik ol lajwok juntzanh skil tik? ¿Jantakto tiempo ol yak' jun yajb'il yuj Dios tik sk'exan silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u? ¿B'aq'uinh ol och waan stek'jiem heb' soldado yik satcha'anh yet' jun Lugar Yiknhej Dios Yaji? xchi.

Ix tak'wi junxo ángel chi' icha tik: Hato yik ol lajwokek' 2,300 el manh ol ak'chaj silab' t'a yemk'ualil yet' t'a q'uinhib'alil. Hato ta' ol lajwok juntzanh chi'. Ichato chi', ol ik'jokel jun tas manh wach'ok ayoch t'a Lugar Yiknhej Dios Yaji, xchi jun ángel chi'.
Ha in Daniel in tik, wanto in naan tas ix wil chi', yik snachajel wuuj tas syalelk'ochi. Haxo ix wilani, ay jun icha yilji anima ix sch'oxk'e sb'a t'a wichanh.
Ix wab'an yoch jun aw skot t'a sti' ha' Ulai, icha wal sjaj anima, ix yalan icha tik: Gabriel, wach' alej t'a jun winh winak tik yik snachajel yuj winh tas ix yil chi', xchi.

Haxo ix jawi ángel Gabriel chi' t'a in tz'ey. Ix in em kumnajok, ix emk'och snanhal in sat t'a sat lu'um yuj xiwelal. Ix yalan t'ayin: Ach anima, ojtakejeli to a tas ix il chi', hato t'a slajwub' tiempoal ol ujok, xchi.
Ayik wanto slolon chi' t'ayin, ix in ek' lian t'a sat lu'um. Ix satel in k'ool, yuj chi' ix och yub'naj t'ayin, ix in sketzank'e linhan.
Ix yalan t'ayin: Ol wal t'ayach tas ol ujok ayik toxo ol lajwok yowal sk'ol Dios. Ha jun tas ix il chi', a lajwub' k'ual sch'oxkoti.
Ha nok' kalnel chab' sch'ak ix il chi', haton heb' winh sreyal Media yet' Persia sch'ox nok'.
Haxo pax nok' mam chiwa ix il chi', haton winh sreyal Grecia sch'ox nok'. Ha jun sch'aak nok' niwakil ayk'eta t'a skal yol sat, a jun winh b'ab'el rey sch'oxo'.
Ha chanhe' ch'aak ix k'eul sk'exulok jun ix kanhchajb'at chi', syalelk'ochi to ol spoj snanhal jun nación chi'. Chanhe' nacional ol ajelk'ochok, palta manh lajanok yip yet' jun b'ab'el.
Ayik toxo ol lajwokek' yopisio juntzanh nación chi', ayik ol tz'akwok chukalil t'a yichanh Dios, ay jun rey ol ak'an yajalil, malaj tz'och tas t'ay, te jelan yak'an musansatil.

Ol yik' wal yip sik'lab'il, palta manhok yet' yip t'a yol yiko'. Satub'tak ol yutej satanel tastak. Wach' ol elk'och t'a tas ol sk'ulej. Ol ak'jok ganar heb' soldado te ay yip yuj yet' heb' yikxo Dios.

Yuj sjelanil, ol yal yixtan heb' anima, ol ste ik'ejchaanh sb'a. Tzijtum anima ol sateli ayik malaj jab'ok tas sna heb'. Ol stek'b'ej sb'a t'a yichanh Dios, Jun Yajalil heb' yajal. Wach'chom icha chi' ol yutok sb'a, palta ol satjokelok, manh yujok spoder anima.

Ha tas ix il t'a silab' tz'ak'ji t'a yemk'ualil yet' t'a q'uinhib'alil, tik wal ix wach' alchajel t'ayach. Ha jun chi' yowalil ol elk'ochok. Kanokab'nhej t'a a pensar, malajokab' b'aj tzala', yujto a juntzanh chi', ol elk'ochok ayik te niwanxo tiempo ol ek'ok, xchi ángel Gabriel chi'.

Ha inxo Daniel in tik, ix te el wip ix wab'i. Ix in penaayax jaye' k'ual. Ixlajwi chi', ix in k'e waan, ix b'at wilanxi wopisio ayoch yuj winh rey. Palta te ilk'olal waj yuj jun ix ch'oxchaj wil chi', yujto max nachajel wuj tas wal syalelk'ochi.

Ha winhaj Darío yuninal winhaj Asuero yinhtilal heb' medo, ix och winh reyal t'a smakb'en heb' caldeo. Ha t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winh t'a yajalil chi', a in Daniel in tik, wan in k'ayb'an juntzanh ch'anh libro b'aj lolonnak Jehová t'a winhaj Jeremías, haton winh schekab'. Yuj chi' ix nachajel wuuj to a Jerusalén, 70 ab'il ol kan tzinan.
Yuj chi' ix in lesalwi, ix in tewi t'a Dios Kajal. Ix in ochpax t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ix wak'anoch pichul yik tzek'ojk'olal chi', ix in em k'ojan t'a skal k'een tik'aq'uil taanh.

Ix in lesalwi t'a Jehová in Diosal, ix walan in b'a t'ay icha tik: Mamin, Wajal ach, te niwan elk'ochi, te satub'tak yilji a poder. Tzak'elk'och a trato yik tzak'an a wach'k'olal t'a heb' tzach xajanani, haton heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il.
Ix och ko chukal yet' ko pital t'ayach. Haxonhej chukal ix ko k'ulej. Ix ko patikejkanel a cheknab'il yet' a k'ayb'ub'al.
Maj ko maklej kab' tas ix yal heb' a chekab'. Yalnak a lolonel heb' t'a heb' ko reyal, t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal, t'a heb' ko mam kicham yet' t'a masanil heb' ketchonhab'.

Ach Mamin Kajal, te tojol a pensar, xal onh israel onh tik, q'uixwelaltak kajek' skab'i. Ha heb' kotnak t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo heb' ketisraelal kajan t'a najat yet' t'a lak'an, ix onh a saklemejkanb'ati, yujto manh k'anab'ajumok ix kutej ko b'a t'ayach.
Ha onh tik Mamin Jehová, q'uixawtak ko k'ool t'a ichanh, yujto ix och ko mul t'ayach yet' pax heb' ko reyal, heb' yajal yaj t'a ko kal yet' pax heb' ko mam kicham.
Palta a ach tik Mamin, ko Diosal ach, te ay ok'elk'olal yet' a niwank'olal, wach'chom a onh tik haxonhej pitalil sko k'ulej t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, maj ach ko k'anab'ajej icha ix aj a chekan yal heb' a chekab' t'ayonh.

Ha onh tik, ko masanil ix ko tenek' a cheknab'il, ix ach ko patikejeli, manhxalaj ko gana ix kab' tas ix ala'. Yuj ko mul chi', ix jawi masanil juntzanh yaelal t'a kib'anh, haton tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yol ch'anh libro stz'ib'ejnakkan winh a chekab' aj Moisés.
Toxo ix elk'och tas ix ala' to ol jawok t'a kib'anh a onh tik yet' t'a heb' kajalil. Te niwan ix aj ak'an syaelal Jerusalén t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Masanil juntzanh yaelal tz'ib' yajkan t'a ch'anh libro yuj winhaj Moisés, ix jawi t'a kib'anh tiknaik. Palta anhej t'a spatik chukal ix onh b'atkani, majxo ko k'anab'ajej a lolonel yik tzak' a wach'k'olal t'ayonh.
Yuj wal chi' Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, ix a na' ak'kot jun niwan yaelal tik t'a kib'anh. Ha ach tik, tojol ach t'a masanil tas tza k'ulej, a onhxo tik, maj ko b'alaj chaej kab' t'ayach.

Ach ko Diosal Kajal ach, a ch'oxnak wal a niwan poder ayik ik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto. Yuj chi' te b'inajnak ach masanto tiknaik, palta a onh tik jun, ix och ko mul, anhej chukal sko k'ulej.

Mamin Kajal, kojtak to tza k'ulejnhej tas tzala'. Yuj chi' elok wal t'a a k'ol ik'anel yaelal yet' yowal a k'ol ayoch t'a yib'anh chonhab' Jerusalén, yujto a chonhab' yaji, ikpax yaj tzalan Sion. Masanil nación ay t'a slak'anil sb'uchwaj heb' t'a a chonhab' chi', yujnhej ko chukal yet' yuj schukal heb' ko mam kicham.
Ach ko Diosal, ab' wal in lesal yet' b'aj tzin tewi a in a chekab' in tik. Yuj wal a b'inaji, ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh a templo tzinan yajkani.
Cha ab' Mamin, ilnab' wal tas yaji, tzinan yajkan jun a chonhab' sb'inaj to ik yaji. Manh yujok ko wach'il t'a yol kiko' tzonh tewi t'ayach, palta a wal yuj a niwan wach'k'olal.

Mamin Kajalil, tak'wej onh, ak' lajwok ko chukal. Kotanh, kolwajanh ket'ok. Yuj wal a b'inajnakil, mokab' ek' tiempo onh a kolani, yujto ojtakab'il to ik onh yet' a chonhab' Jerusalén, xin chi t'a in lesal chi'.
Yakb'an wannhej in lesalwi, wan walank'eta in mul yet' smul heb' wetchonhab' israel, tzin tewioch t'a Jehová in Diosal yuj tzalan Sion yiknhej yaji.
Yakb'an wan in lesalwi chi', haxo ángel Gabriel, jun sch'oxnak sb'a t'ayin t'a yalanhtaxo, ix jawi jenhenhok b'aj ayinek' chi', ichawal yorail yik tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová t'a yemk'ualil.
Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Daniel, tzin jawi t'ayach yik tzul wak'an a jelanil yik snachajel uuj tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh heb' etchonhab'.

Ayik ix a yamanoch a lesalwi, ha Dios ix pakan a lesal chi', yuj chi' tzin jawi ul wal t'ayach, yujto te xajan ach yuj Dios. Ha tiknaik, maklej ab' tas ol wal t'ayach yik ol nachajel uuj tas ol ak'jok il tik.

Ol ek' 70 semana t'a yib'anh heb' etisraelal yet' t'a yib'anh a chonhab' to yiknhej Dios yaji, masanto yik ol lajwokek' pitalil yet' chukal, haxo yak'ji tup masanil mul, hata', tojolnhej ol aj t'a smasanil tiempo. Ol elk'och masanil tas ix ch'oxji yil heb' schekab' Dios yet' tas alb'ilkan yuj heb'. Ol ak'chajoch jun lugar yiknhej Dios yaj t'a yopisio.

Yowalil ol nachajel jun tik uuj: Ayik ol alchajok to ol b'ochajxik'e chonhab' Jerusalén, ol ek' uke' semana b'ab'el, slajwi chi' ol ek' pax 62 semana. Ichato chi' ol ja jun Yajal to sik'b'ileli. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ol b'ochajxik'e scalleal yet' smuroal Jerusalén chi' t'a skal jantak yaelal.

Ayik toxo ix lajwiek' 62 semana chi', ol miljokcham jun Yajal sik'b'ilel chi', ichato malaj tas syik'a'. Slajwi chi' ol juchajem templo yet' chonhab' Jerusalén yuj heb' anima ayoch yet' jun yajal ol jawok. Icha wal yel ha' eluma', icha chi' ol aj slajwiel Jerusalén chi'. Ha tas nab'il yuj Dios, ol ochnhej owal yet' somchajb'ail masanto t'a slajwub' k'ual.

Ha jun yajal ol jawok chi', tzijtum heb' anima ol yak' pural yik sb'oan strato yet'ok t'a junok semana, palta t'a wal snanhalb'i jun semana chi', haxo skachanoch waan yak'chaj silab' yet' ofrenda t'a Dios. Haxo jun yajal chuk chi', ol yak'och tas to yajb'il yuj Dios t'a yol templo. Aynhejek' ta', masanto ol yak'kot Dios tas nab'il yuj t'a yib'anh jun yajal chuk chi', xchi ángel Gabriel chi' t'ayin.

Ha t'a yoxil ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, ix alchajxi slolonel Dios t'ayin Daniel in tik, Beltsasar pax in b'i. Icha wayich ix aj yalji t'ayin. Ha jun tas ix wab' chi', te yel, syal yuj jun niwan owal, palta ix nachajel wuuj tas syalelk'ochi.
Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi', oxe' semana ix in och t'a kusk'olal.
Malaj wael wach' ix in wa''a, maj in nib'ej jab'ok chib'ej, maj wuk' pax wino, malaj wal jab'ok perfume ix wak'och t'ayin, masanto ix ek' oxe' semana chi'.
Ayik 24 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yik ab'il chi', ayinek' t'a sti' ha' niwan Tigris.
Ix in b'at k'elan, ix wilan jun winh winak ayoch spichul nab'a lino yet' jun stzek'ul nab'a oro te wach'.

Toxonhej skopopi sniwanil icha k'een topacio, toxonhej kopopi yilji sat icha lheb'lon. Ha yol sat, sk'e nhilnhon yok icha te' k'ak'. Ha sk'ab' yet' yok, kopopi yilji icha k'een bronce wach' yaj snhikchaji, haxo sjaj, ichawal yoch sjaj junok niwan nhilanh anima.
Ha innhej ix yal wilan jun chi', haxo masanil heb' anima ayek' wet'ok, maj yil-laj heb', yujto ix jawi xiwelal t'a heb', ix b'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a.
Ha inxonhej ayinek' in ch'okoj ayik ix wilan jun chi', ix tup in chiq'uil, manhxa wip ix wab'i.
Ayik ix wab'an slolonk'e jun chi', ix te pax wip, ix satel in k'ool, ix in em nhojnaj t'a sat lu'um.
Haxo ix aji, ix och yub'yub' jun k'ab' t'ayin, ix in sketzank'e waan, masanto ix yal in k'e kuman yet' sjolom in penek yet' in k'ab'.

Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Daniel, ach xajanab'il yuj Dios, schamwal ab'an tas ol wala'. Q'ueanh waan, yujto in chekjikot t'ayach, xchi. Ha wal yik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh lolonel chi', toxonhej tzin lukloni, ix in k'e linhan.

Ichato chi' ix yalan t'ayin: Daniel, manh ach xiwok. Yiktax ix a chaanel yich och ejmelal, yik tza k'anan a jelanil, yik snachajel tas ajaltak uuj, ha Dios ix ab'an a lesal. Yuj chi' in chekjikot t'ayach.

Ha jun ángel yajal yaj t'a yol yik Persia, ha' ix in yamanoch waan t'a 21 k'ual. Haxo pax Miguel, haton jun sat ángel yaji, ha' ix jawi yik skolwaj wet'ok, ix kan yak' owal yet' jun yajalil Persia chi'.
Yuj chi' a tiknaik, tzul wak' nachajel uuj tas ol ek' t'a yib'anh a chonhab' tik t'a slajwub' tiempoal. Ha jun ol ch'oxchaj ila', a yuj tas ol ujok t'a slajwub' tiempoal syala', xchi.
Ayik wan yalan juntzanh lolonel chi' t'ayin, majxo yal-laj in loloni, toxonhej ix in em k'elan t'a sat lu'um.

Haxo ix aji, ay jun lajan yilji icha anima, elanhchamel ix syam in ti'. Haxo ix walan t'a jun linhanoch t'a wichanh chi': Mamin, a yuj jun tas ix wil tik, ix och wal pitz'an t'a in k'ool, manhxalaj wip swab'i.
Mamin, ¿tas wal ol aj in lolon het'ok a in a chekab' in tik, yujto manhxalaj wip, maxtzak yal-laj wik'an wik' swab'i? xin chi.
Haxo jun lajan yilji icha anima chi', ix ochxi yamyam t'ayin, ix wik'anxi wip.

Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach xiwok, manh ak' pensar. Te xajan ach yuj Dios. Anhej to tza tek'b'ej a b'a, xchi. Yakb'an wanto slolon chi' t'ayin, ix wik'an wal wip ix wab'i, ix walani: Mamin, lolonanh t'ayin, yujto ix ochxi wip junelxo uuj, xin chi t'ay.

Ix yalan t'ayin: ¿Ojtak hama tas yuj tzin jawi t'ayach? Ol wal t'ayach tas tz'ib'ab'ilem t'a yol ch'anh libro to yel. Ha tiknaik ol wak'pax owal yet' jun ángel yajal yaj t'a Persia. Ayik ol lajwok wak'an owal chi' yet'ok, ol ja jun ángel yajal yaj t'a Grecia. Ha t'a jun owal chi', anhej wal Miguel skolwaj wet'ok, haton jun ángel yajal yaj t'a a chonhab' Israel.
Ha in ix in ochpax yet' winhaj Darío sreyal Media t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winh reyal chi', xchi.

Ix yalanxi t'ayin: Ha tiknaik, ol wak' ojtakejel tas t'inhan ol ujok. Ayto och oxwanh heb' winh rey t'a Persia, slajwi chi' ol och junxo winh schanhil rey. Ha jun winh chi', más te b'eyum winh t'a yichanh heb' oxwanh chi'. Ha yuj sb'eyumal winh chi', ol yik' yip winh, ol yak'an wal owal winh yet' winh sreyal Grecia.
Slajwi chi', ol och jun winh sreyal Grecia chi', te ak'um owal. Ol te lewanb'ok smakb'en chi', ol sk'ulan masanil tas snib'ej.

Palta ayik toxo ix yik' yip yopisio winh chi', chanhpoj ol ajkanb'atok. Ha yopisio jun winh rey chi', manh ol b'eynhejb'at t'a heb' yinhtilal. Ol el yip yopisio winh chi', manhxo lajanok ol aj yip icha t'a sb'ab'elal, yujto chanhpoj ol ajok, ch'okxo pax mach ol ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.

Ha jun winh ol ochkan sreyalok sur, ol ste ik'ej yip winh, palta a junokxo winh yajal soldado te niwan ol aj yopisio t'a yichanh jun winh sreyal sur chi', ol yak'an yajalil winh t'a jun makb'en te lewan chi'.

Haxo yik ol ek' jayeok ab'il, a heb' winh chawanh rey chi', ol sb'o junok strato heb' winh. Ha jun winh sreyal sur chi', ol yak'b'at junok yisil winh t'a winh sreyal norte, yik wach' ay junk'olal t'a skal chab' makb'en chi'. Palta manh ol yal yuj ix yik'an b'ey jun trato yet' winh yetb'eyum chi'. Yuj chi' ol miljokcham ix yet' winh yet' yune' ix yet' pax heb' schekab' ix.
Palta ay junok sk'ab' yok ix ol och reyal, ol yak'an owal yet' heb' soldado yik norte. Ol ak'jok ganar heb' yuj yet' chonhab' b'aj kajan jun winh sreyal norte chi'.

Ol yik'b'at sdiosal heb' ay t'a norte chi' t'a Egipto, haton juntzanh b'ob'il t'a k'een k'een yet' juntzanh syamk'ab' heb' nab'a oro yet' plata. Ol ek'b'at jayeok ab'il, malaj owal ol och t'a skal heb'.
Ol lajwok chi', a jun winh sreyal norte chi', ol yak' owal winh yet' jun winh sreyal sur chi', palta manh ol yal-laj yuj winh, ol meltzaj winh t'a schonhab'.

Palta haxo heb' yuninal winh sreyal norte chi', ol k'e waan heb' yak' owal. Manh jantakok sb'isul soldado heb' ol smolb'ej. Ha junok heb' yuninal winh chi' ol b'at yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winh sreyal sur chi' yik syak'an ganar yalani. Ol ek'b'at heb' icha junok eluma', masanto ol k'och heb' t'a schonhab' winh sreyal sur chi'.
Yuj chi' ol te kot yowal winh sreyal sur chi'. Ol elta winh yak' owal t'a jun nhilanh soldado ajk'ol chi', ol satjokel heb' smasanil yuj winh.
Yujto ol satel jun nhilanh heb' ajk'ol chi' yuj winh, ol yik'anchaanh sb'a winh, tzijtumto juntzanhxo heb' ajk'ool ol smilcham winh, palta manh niwanok tiempo ol yak' yopisio winh chi'.

Ayik ol ek'b'at jayeok ab'il, a winh sreyal norte chi', te ek'b'al niwan heb' soldado ol smolb'ej winh t'a yichanh heb' ix smolb'ej t'a sb'ab'elal, ol b'atxok winh yak' owal yet' winh sreyal sur chi', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal smasanil.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', tzijtum heb' ol och ajk'olal t'a winh sreyal sur chi'. Ha t'a skal heb' chi', ay juntzanh heb' etisraelal te chuk spensar, ol spak sb'a heb' yik tz'elk'och tas ak'b'il yil heb' snaani, palta manh ol yak'laj ganar heb'.

Ol jawok winh sreyal norte chi', ol och hoyan soldado t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' te tek'an, ol ak'jok ganar jun chonhab' chi' yuj heb'. Ha heb' soldado te jelan yik sur, manh ol yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a heb' t'a yichanh winh ajk'ol chi'.

Ha winh ol ak'an ganar chi', ol sk'ulejnhej winh tas snib'ej t'a jun winh ol ak'jok ganar chi'. Manhxalaj mach ol yal stek'b'an sb'a t'a yichanh winh. Ol kan winh t'a sat lum lum te wach', haton Israel, ol satanel winh jantaknhej tas snib'ej.

Ol yak' yip winh yet' heb' soldado yik'anek' slum winh sreyal sur chi'. Ol yak'an jun strato winh yet' winh rey chi', ol yak'anb'at junok yisil winh yetb'eyumok jun winh rey chi', yik syak'an ganar winh yalani, palta manh ol elk'ochlaj icha tas sna winh chi'.

Ol lajwok chi', ol yak'an owal winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' mar. Tzijtum heb' ol ak'jok ganar yuj winh, palta ay jun yajal soldado ol kachan wanaj winh, icha chi' ol aj yel sq'uixwelal winh sreyal norte chi'.
Ol lajwok chi', ol meltzaj winh t'a smakb'en b'aj ay juntzanh schonhab', te ay yip, palta ol ak'jok ganar, ol satelok.

Ch'okxo junxo winh rey ol ochkan sk'exulok winh, a jun winh chi', ol schekb'at junok mach winh, b'at sk'ananel tumin syak' heb' t'a winh, yik sk'ek'och winh yet' yopisio chi' snaani. Palta jayeanto k'ual yoch winh t'a yopisio chi', ol miljokcham winh, manhok t'a skal owal ol cham winh.

Ol lajwok chi', ay jun winh te malaj yelk'och ol och reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi', manh smojok yoch winh t'a yopisio. Manh naanok yuj heb' anima ayik ol och winh reyal chi' yuj yak'an musansatil heb' anima chi'.
Masanil heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'a winh, ol satel heb' yuj winh, ol satpaxel winh sat sacerdote yik Dios.
Ol ak'jokpax musansatil heb' yuj winh, haton heb' ol yak'lej sb'oan strato yet' winh t'a wach'ilal. Wach'chom kennhej anima ayoch yet' winh, palta ol yak'nhej ganar winh.

Ayik manh naanok yuj heb' anima chi', ol och winh t'a sat sluum heb', haton lum te wach'. Ol sk'ulejnhej winh tastak to maj sk'ulej heb' smam yicham. Masanil tas ol yik' winh t'a owal chi', ol spojek' winh t'a skal heb' ajun yet'ok. Ol snib'ej winh yak' owal yet' juntzanh chonhab' to tek'an, palta manh niwanok tiempo ol yal yuj winh.

Ol yak'och sjelanil winh chi' yipok sk'ool, ol yak'an owal winh yet' winh sreyal sur. Niwan sb'isul soldado ol och yet' winh, palta a winh sreyal sur chi' yet' wal yip yet' pax soldado te jelan ol yak'an owal yet' winh. Palta manh ol yal-laj stek'b'an sb'a heb' soldado chi', yujto tonhej ol ak'jok musansatil winh sreyal sur chi'.
Ha heb' yetyajalil winh sreyal sur chi' awtab'il wael yuj t'a smexa, ipan heb' ol meltzajoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ol lajwokel heb' soldado chi', tzijtum heb' ol chamok.

Ha tas nab'il yuj chawanh heb' winh rey chi', anhej yak'an chukal heb' t'ay junjun. Ol mol em k'ojan heb' wael t'a smexa. Ol yak'an es heb' t'ay junjun, palta malaj junok heb' ol elk'och tas snib'ej, yujto manto k'och sk'ual alb'ilkan yuj Dios.

Haxo winh sreyal norte chi', ol meltzajxok winh t'a schonhab' yet' masanil tas ol yik' winh t'a owal chi'. Ol lajwok chi', ol och winh ajk'olal t'a ejmelal syak' heb' israel, haton jun strato Dios sb'onak yet' heb', haxo sk'ulan winh masanil tas nab'il yuj chi'. Ol lajwok chi', ol meltzaj winh t'a smakb'en.
Ayik ol k'och stiempoal nab'il yuj Dios, ol b'atxok winh yet' heb' soldado yak' owal t'a sur. Palta ha t'a junelxo chi', manhxo ol yak'laj ganar winh icha t'a sb'ab'elal.

Yujto a heb' soldado t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ol jawok heb' t'a yol barco. Ha heb' chi' ol kachanoch waan winh. Icha chi' ol aj xiw winh sreyal norte chi', haxo smeltzaj winh chi' t'a spatik. Yuj chi', haxo t'a yib'anh strato Dios yet' heb' israel ol smak'el yowal sk'ol winh. Ol schaan winh yab' tas ol yal heb' aktannakkan jun trato chi'.

Haxo heb' soldado chi', ol yixtejb'at stemplo Dios heb' yet' cuartel junnhej yaj yet'ok. Ol syamoch waan heb' yak'chaj silab' t'a junjun k'u. Haxo tas yajb'ilel yuj Dios, a ol yak'och heb' t'a yol templo chi' yik syixtanel heb'.
Ol smontej heb' etisraelal jun winh rey chi', haton heb' toxo ix aktankan strato Dios. Haxo pax heb' chonhab' xajanan sDiosal, ol stek'b'ej sb'a heb' t'a yichanh tas ol ujok chi'.

Ay heb' jelan t'a skal heb' etchonhab' ol k'ayb'an tzijtumok heb' etchonhab' chi', palta ay heb' ol miljokchamok, ay heb' ol nhusjoktz'aok, ay heb' ol elk'ajb'at tastak ay t'ay, ay pax heb' ol ik'jokb'at chekab'il.
Ayik ol k'och stiempoal spechchaj b'eyek' heb', malaj wal mach ol kolwaj t'a heb'. Tzijtum mach junnhej ol yutej sb'a yet' heb', palta chab'sat juntzanh heb' chi'.

Ol miljokcham jaywanhok heb' k'ayb'um jelan t'a skal a chonhab' chi', yik wach' ol ak'chaj prowal juntzanhxo heb' olto kanok, yik wach' tz'ik'chajel heb' chab'sat chi' t'a skal heb', haxo stojolb'i spensar heb' chi', masanto ol k'och slajwub' tiempoal nab'il yuj Dios.

Ha winh sreyal norte chi', ol sk'ulej winh icha tas snib'ej, ichaton chi' ol aj yik'anchaanh sb'a winh, ol yalan winh to niwan yelk'och winh t'a yichanh komon Dios. Ol yal b'uchwal lolonel winh t'a Dios te yel. Ol sk'ulejnhej masanil tas ol snib'ej winh masanto ol jawok yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh winh, yujto a tas nab'il yuj Dios chi', ol elk'ochok.

Ha jun winh rey chi', malaj yelk'och sdiosal heb' smam yicham winh t'ay. Malaj pax yelk'och tas nib'ab'il yuj heb' ix ix t'a yol sat winh yet' pax komon Dios, yujto a jun winh chi', ol yal winh to ek'b'al niwan yelk'och winh t'a yichanh masanil juntzanh chi'.

Palta ch'ok jun Dios b'aj ol och winh ejmelal, haton t'a jun Dios b'aj manh yak'nakokem sb'a heb' smam yicham winh, haton jun Dios stanhwan chonhab' to tek'an. Ol yak'an silab' winh t'ay, haton k'een oro, k'een plata, k'een k'een te wach' yilji yet' juntzanhxo tastak to te karo stojol.

Ha yuj skolwal jun ch'ok diosal chi', ol yak' ganar juntzanh chonhab' te ay yip winh. Ha heb' ol yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' jun winh rey chi', ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a juntzanh niwak opisio yuj winh, ol ak'chaj lum lum stojolok heb'.

Ayik ol k'och slajwub' tiempoal chi', a winh sreyal sur, ol yak' owal winh yet' jun winh sreyal norte chi'. Palta ol elta winh sreyal norte chi' yak' owal yet' winh yet' wal smasanil yipal. Ol elta winh yet' scarruaje yik owal yet' heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej. Tzijtum pax barco ol kot yet' winh. Tzijtum nación ol yak' ganar winh, yujto icha sb'ey ha' eluma' sb'ey heb' soldado winh.
Ol ochpax winh t'a lum lum te wach'. Tzijtum nación ol yak' ganar winh. Haxo pax heb' kajan t'a Edom yet' t'a Moab ol kolchajkanel heb', ek'b'alto pax nanhal heb' aj Amón ol kolchajok.
Ol yik'paxek' juntzanhxo nación winh, manhxo ol techajpax skolan sb'a Egipto t'a winh.
Ol ik'chajb'at masanil sb'eyumal Egipto chi', icha k'een oro, k'een plata yet' juntzanhxo tas wach'. Ol kanpax heb' aj Libia yet' heb' aj Etiopía t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Palta ol jawok yab'ixal heb' kajan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' t'a norte t'a winh, ol och winh t'a xiwk'olal yuj. Yuj chi' ol elta winh yet' yowal sk'ool, te niwan anima ol sna' winh smilchamok.
Ol sb'oank'e scampamento winh t'a skal ha' mar yet' jun tzalan b'aj ay stemplo Dios, haton ta' ol k'och stiempoal satel winh, manhxa junok mach ol kolan winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', a ángel Miguel, sat ángel yaji, stanhwumal heb' etchonhab' israel, ol och waan. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' te ay wal niwan yaelal. Manta junelok ix uji jun chi' yiktax ix el yich spitzwik'e waan juntzanh nación. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay heb' etchonhab' ol kolchajok, syalelk'ochi, haton heb' tz'ib'ab'il sb'i t'a yol ch'anh libro yik Dios.
Tzijtum heb' chamnakxo ol pitzwokpaxi. Ay juntzanh heb' ol chaan sk'inal t'a junelnhej. Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' ol b'atkan t'a skal q'uixwelal, ol yajchajkanel heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha heb' jelan, heb' ix kuchb'an tzijtum anima t'a wach' b'eyb'al, ol cheklaj heb' t'a masanil tiempo icha skopopial yilji k'een k'anal ay t'a satcha'anh.

Palta a ach tik Daniel, makkan jun libro tik. Tza sik'ankani masanto ol jawok slajwub'al tiempo chi', tzak'ankanoch sello t'ay. Tzijtum anima ol b'at tik, ol b'at tik yuj snib'an yojtakejeli tas wan yuji, xchi jun ángel chi' t'ayin.
Ix wilan chawanhxo heb' winak linhanek' t'a sti' ha' niwan Tigris, junjun heb' t'a junjun stitak ha'.
Ha junok heb' chi' ix k'anb'an t'a jun winak ayoch pichul lino yuj, linhanek' t'a yib'anhk'e heb', ix yalan icha tik: ¿B'aq'uinh wal ol lajwok juntzanh tas ayxo smay yilji tik? xchi t'ay.

Haxo jun winak ayoch pichul lino yuj chi', ix yik'chaanh sk'ab', ix yak'an sti' t'a yichanh Dios aynhejeq'ui, ix yalani: Ayik ol lajwok nanhal schanhil ab'il, ayik manhxalaj yip heb' schonhab' Dios ol kan yuj heb' ajk'ol chi', ichato chi' ol lajwokek' masanil juntzanh tik, xchi.
Ix wab' wal tas ix yala', palta maj nachajel-laj wuuj. Yuj chi' ix in k'anb'ej t'ay icha tik: Mamin, ¿tas wal ol aj slajwiek' masanil juntzanh tik? xin chi.
Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Manto a na yuj juntzanh tik Daniel, yujto masanil juntzanh tik, tonhej ol sik'chajkanok masanto ol jawok slajwub'.

Yuj juntzanh yaelal chi' tzijtum heb' anima ol ik'jokkanel smul, ol tojolb'okkan spensar, haxo heb' chuk jun, ol k'enhejchaanh heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh ol nachajel yuj heb' tas wan yuji chi'. Haxo heb' anima jelan chi', ol nachajel yuj heb'.
Ayik ol yamchajoch waan yak'chaj silab' t'a junjun k'u yet' yik ol ak'chajoch tas yajb'il yuj Dios t'a yol stemplo yik tz'ixtaxeli, ichato chi' b'ian, ol el yich jun mil 290 k'ual.
Te tzalajk'olal yik heb' tek'an ol yutej sb'a masanto ol tz'akwok mil 335 k'ual.
Palta a ach tik, tek'annhej tzutej a b'a masanto t'a slajwub'al, ichato chi' ol ik'an ip. Hato t'a slajwub' k'ual, ol ach pitzwokxi, haxo a chaan spak chi', xchi t'ayin.
